name: Gallantmon
main_effect:
[When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 8000 DP or less. If this effect didn't delete, this Digimon gains ＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.) and gets +3000 DP until the end of your opponent's turn.
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon is deleted, gain 2 memory.
